items.title: LiteLLM Compromised, Steals Credentials
items.summary: In a new incident, a malicious version (1.107.0)  of the LiteLLM package was uploaded to PyPI and Docker on October 21. The malicious version includes a credential stealer targeting browser, cloud and AI secrets as well as a dormant C2 capability.
items.creator: Benjamin Read

items.title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE vulnerabilities affecting 70% of the Internet
items.summary: Core PHP engine flaws enable remote code execution and Heartbleed-style memory disclosure across the web.
items.creator: Sagi Tzadik
